name: STAR Cultural Religion & Magic Knowledge
variation_model: 10 lenses x 10 depths x 10 formats per canonical node
truthfulness_note: 5M are deterministic addressable study/research views over 5,000 canonical cultural nodes; they are not 5M independently researched facts

epistemic_policy.practitioner_self_description: attribute beliefs and internal claims to the relevant tradition/community
epistemic_policy.scholarship: distinguish historical, anthropological, sociological and textual interpretations
epistemic_policy.supernatural_claims: do not present supernatural efficacy as an established physical mechanism without independent evidence
epistemic_policy.internal_diversity: do not treat one denomination, school, teacher or community as representative of the whole tradition
epistemic_policy.living_communities: prefer current community-authored/self-descriptive sources when describing living identities and practices
epistemic_policy.restricted_indigenous_knowledge: do not reconstruct closed ceremonies, initiatory knowledge or community-restricted details from fragments
epistemic_policy.harmful_rituals: historical description is allowed, but dangerous ingestion, poisoning, violence or other harmful procedures are not operationalized as instructions

source_families.name: Database of Religious History (University of British Columbia)
source_families.role: scholar-authored standardized historical religion data, qualitative commentary and references

source_families.name: Harvard Pluralism Project
source_families.role: religious diversity, self-description, interfaith context and tradition overviews

source_families.name: Pew Research Center Religion
source_families.role: contemporary demography and survey-based religious landscape data; not doctrine authority

source_families.name: Library of Congress Religion Collections / American Folklife Center
source_families.role: religion, vernacular religion, folklore, ritual, historical magic and archival discovery

source_families.name: Smithsonian Anthropology
source_families.role: anthropology, ethnology, material culture, archives and community-facing collections

source_families.name: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage
source_families.role: living traditions, oral traditions, rituals, festive events and cultural safeguarding

source_families.name: Sefaria
source_families.role: open structured Jewish texts, metadata and intertextual links

source_families.name: SuttaCentral
source_families.role: structured early Buddhist texts and metadata

source_families.name: OpenAlex + Crossref
source_families.role: scholarly discovery, metadata, citations/DOIs and current research expansion through Research Hub

copyright_policy: the repository stores taxonomy, derived metadata and original summaries/guidance; full copyrighted texts are not copied without a compatible license
